Explanation of ara::com API
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
5.3.8 Triggers
Triggers
are simply a class of dataless events. Which means that all the documenta-
tion in Chapter 5.3.5 is also applicable for
Triggers
, except for the data related part,
which is described in this section.
From
Proxy
point of view, subscribing to a
Trigger
is the same as described in
Chapter 5.3.5.1 without the local cache part.
